class.name: InputMapSettingsRow
class.brief_description: One action as stored in the file of [InputMapSettingsServer].
class.description: The file form of an [InputAction] in the settings file of [InputMapSettingsServer]: the events are written as one text cell ([member bindings]), so a CSV file has one row per action. [InputMapSettingsServer] converts between [InputActions] and these rows when it saves and loads; games do not need this class.

members.member: The events of the action as text, as written by [method InputMapSettingsServer.events_to_text], for example [code]Key:Ctrl+J; JoypadButton:A[/code].
